title: skills(objectstack-platform): an eval case for the push capability and push stack key (follow-up of #29820)
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhJG3tKnksHVa1krBz

Filing gate: the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #29968 (card #29820), filed by `domain:spec` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2.

## What happens

PR #29968 adds the `push` platform capability (`@objectstack/service-push`) and the top-level `push` stack key. To keep `check:skill-top-level-keys` green it also adds `push` to `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, in the key list and in the `requires` table. No eval in `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/` exercises either. `config-plugins-ops.json` covers the neighbouring `email` / `sms` capabilities, but it has no prompt that asks an agent to turn push on from a stack file. So a regression in what the skill teaches about push would go unmeasured.

## Wanted

1. One eval case in `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json`: asked to turn on push notifications for an `os serve` deployment, the agent declares `requires: ['push']` and a `push: { transport: 'direct', apns | fcm: { credentialRef, ... } }` block, and puts no secret inline.
2. The case also pins the current relay status: a `push: {}` / `transport: 'relay'` answer is wrong until the hosted relay sender (#29920) ships, and the right answer says so.

Out of this card: the skill's `requires` table already omitted `mailbox` and `package-registry` before #29968 (the dev's out-of-scope finding); file that separately if the skills lane wants it.

Serial: after PR #29968.

Links back: #29820, PR #29968, #29920.
